english.title: Operator of packaging waste scheme fail to comply with data reporting obligations - Wales
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the operator of a registered packaging waste scheme in Wales, failed to carry out the data reporting obligations under regulation 17 of the Packaging Waste (Data Collection and Reporting) (Wales) Regulations 2023 of each producer who was a member of the scheme that you operated in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 20(1) and 28(3)(a) and (7) of the Packaging Waste (Data Collection and Reporting) (Wales) Regulations 2023.
english.pointstoprove: date and locationwas the operator of a registered packaging waste scheme in Walesfailed to carry out the data reporting obligations under regulation 17 for each producer that was a member of the scheme

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Please note, there is an error in regulation 28(3)(a) of the Packaging Waste (Data Collection and Reporting) (Wales) Regulations 2023 which creates this offence. regulation 28(3)(a) refers to regulation 21(1) however, this appears to be an error and should in fact state regulation 20(1) which sets out general provisions for registered schemes as per the offence wording and details above.
